findings.current: Go fetch me a bird’s nest because I feel like eating one…
findings.defect: The requested object is changed from bird eggs to a bird’s nest, conflating this initial exercise with the later swallow’s-nest task.
findings.rationale: 새알 means bird eggs, whereas the later 제비집 explicitly means a swallow’s nest.
findings.replacement: Go fetch me some bird eggs because I feel like eating them…

findings.current: One shichen a day. Other than the honey-sweet hours of sleep, everything was part of my training.
findings.defect: The fragment fails to state that his sole daily respite is one shichen of sleep, and “hours” obscures the explicit quantity.
findings.rationale: 하루 한 시진 identifies the duration of the 꿀 같은 수면 시간, while the following clause says everything outside that sleep was training.
findings.replacement: I got one shichen of blissful sleep a day. Other than that, everything was part of my training.
findings.source: 하루 한 시진. 꿀 같은 수면 시간을 제외하면 모든 것이 수련의 일환이었다.

findings.current: On one of Mount Jiuhua’s high peaks, painted in vivid colors, Jeok Cheongang woke with a start after falling asleep with his back against a tree.
findings.defect: “Woke with a start” invents a sudden, startled action; the source says he opened his eyes groggily.
findings.rationale: 부스스 describes a disheveled, groggy awakening rather than a startled one, which matters because his unusual sleepiness is a warning sign.
findings.replacement: On one of Mount Jiuhua’s high peaks, painted in vivid colors, Jeok Cheongang, who had been sleeping with his back against a tree, groggily opened his eyes.
findings.source: 형형색색으로 물든 구화산의 높은 봉우리, 나무에 등을 기댄 채 잠에 빠져 있던 적천강이 부스스 눈을 떴다.

findings.current: Just as I expected, Jeok Cheongang suddenly offered the urns a formal bow.
findings.defect: “Formal bow” does not preserve the physical action of 큰절, a full kneeling bow, as confirmed by his subsequently rising.
findings.rationale: 큰절 denotes a deep ceremonial bow performed from the knees, not merely an unspecified formal inclination.
findings.replacement: Just as I expected, Jeok Cheongang abruptly dropped to his knees and bowed deeply before the urns.
findings.source: 내 짐작대로 적천강은 항아리들을 향해 대뜸 큰절을 올렸다.

findings.defect: The translation inserts the narrator as the subject, changing the mechanism; the surrounding context concerns his internal energy reacting as though it has returned to its origin.
findings.rationale: The Korean deliberately omits the subject, and the immediately surrounding sentences point to the internal energy rather than Taekyung himself. The replacement preserves that omission.

findings.current: The Fire Gate Clan had been passed down for hundreds of years to a single person at a time—someone talented enough not to commit evil deeds.
findings.defect: “Talented enough not to commit evil deeds” incorrectly makes moral restraint a consequence of sufficient talent.
findings.rationale: 인재 supplies the recipient’s talent, while 악한 일을 행하지 않을 만한 independently characterizes that person as trustworthy enough not to do evil.
findings.replacement: The Fire Gate Clan had been passed down for hundreds of years to a single person at a time—one talented individual who could be trusted not to commit evil deeds.
findings.source: 단 한 사람, 악한 일을 행하지 않을 만한 인재에게 수백 년간 계승되어 온 열화문이다.

findings.current: “Old Master. I’m only asking out of curiosity.”
findings.defect: The draft adds curiosity as Taekyung’s motive and loses the cautious conversational hedge he uses before asking about Jeok Cheongang’s health.
findings.rationale: 그냥 여쭤보는 건데요 softens the impending sensitive question without saying that it is motivated by curiosity.
findings.replacement: “Old Master. I just want to ask you something.”

findings.current: For a moment, I considered logging out.
findings.defect: The binding System terminology requires the established term “Logout,” which is absent.
findings.rationale: 로그아웃 is explicitly mapped to the System term Logout.
findings.replacement: For a moment, I considered using Logout.

findings.defect: The existing shichen footnote is never referenced, leaving an unused Markdown footnote definition.
findings.rationale: This is the first meaningful occurrence of the culturally specific time unit and should reference the already supplied explanatory footnote.

findings.current: “An additional hundred geun. From now on, we’re increasing it to twelve shichen.”
findings.defect: The existing geun footnote is never referenced, leaving an unused Markdown footnote definition.
findings.rationale: This is the first meaningful occurrence of the traditional weight unit and should reference the already supplied explanatory footnote.
findings.replacement: “An additional hundred geun[^1]. From now on, we’re increasing it to twelve shichen.”
findings.source: 백 근 추가. 앞으로는 열두 시진으로 늘린다.

summary: Two critical fidelity errors change the requested object and assign an omitted subject incorrectly. Additional findings concern a stated sleep quantity, altered physical actions, a lost pragmatic hedge, characterization, binding terminology, and unused footnotes.
